12:16.kjv: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.

12:17.web: Yahweh afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
12:17.kjv: And the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai Abram’s wife.

12:18.web: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?
12:18.kjv: And Pharaoh called Abram, and said, What is this that thou hast done unto me? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife?

12:19.web: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”
12:19.kjv: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.

12:20.web: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.
12:20.kjv: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him: and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.

13:1.web: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.
13:1.kjv: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.

13:2.web: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
13:2.kjv: And Abram was very rich in cattle, in silver, and in gold.

13:3.web: He went on his journeys from the South even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
13:3.kjv: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;

13:4.web: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on Yahweh’s name.
13:4.kjv: Unto the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first: and there Abram called on the name of the LORD.

13:5.web: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.
13:5.kjv: And Lot also, which went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

13:6.web: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their substance was great, so that they could not live together.
13:6.kjv: And the land was not able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, so that they could not dwell together.

13:7.web: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.
13:7.kjv: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram’s cattle and the herdmen of Lot’s cattle: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land.

bsb: between you and me, or between
13:8.web: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.
13:8.kjv: And Abram said unto Lot, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdmen and thy herdmen; for we be brethren.

bsb: I will go to the right;
I will go to the left.”
13:9.web: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”
13:9.kjv: Is not the whole land before thee? separate thyself, I pray thee, from me: if thou wilt take the left hand, then I will go to the right; or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left.

13:10.web: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.
13:10.kjv: And Lot lifted up his eyes, and beheld all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered every where, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, even as the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as thou comest unto Zoar.

13:11.web: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves the one from the other.
13:11.kjv: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.

13:12.web: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
13:12.kjv: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain, and pitched his tent toward Sodom.

13:13.web: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.
13:13.kjv: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.

13:14.web: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
13:14.kjv: And the LORD said unto Abram, after that Lot was separated from him, Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward, and southward, and eastward, and westward:

13:15.web: for all the land which you see, I will give to you, and to your offspring forever.
13:15.kjv: For all the land which thou seest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed for ever.

13:16.web: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.
13:16.kjv: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth: so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then shall thy seed also be numbered.

13:17.web: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”
13:17.kjv: Arise, walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it; for I will give it unto thee.

13:18.web: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.
13:18.kjv: Then Abram removed his tent, and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and built there an altar unto the LORD.

14:1.web: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,
14:1.kjv: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;

14:2.web: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
14:2.kjv: That these made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, which is Zoar.

14:3.web: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).
14:3.kjv: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

14:4.web: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year, they rebelled.
14:4.kjv: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

14:5.web: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
14:5.kjv: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer, and the kings that were with him, and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzims in Ham, and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

14:6.web: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
14:6.kjv: And the Horites in their mount Seir, unto El-paran, which is by the wilderness.

14:7.web: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.
14:7.kjv: And they returned, and came to En-mishpat, which is Kadesh, and smote all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites that dwelt in Hazezon-tamar.

14:8.web: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim;
14:8.kjv: And there went out the king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar;) and they joined battle with them in the vale of Siddim;

14:9.web: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.
14:9.kjv: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

14:10.web: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there, and those who remained fled to the hills.
14:10.kjv: And the vale of Siddim was full of slimepits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and fell there; and they that remained fled to the mountain.

bsb: and they went on their way.
14:11.web: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.
14:11.kjv: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their victuals, and went their way.

14:12.web: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
14:12.kjv: And they took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

14:13.web: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and they were allies of Abram.
14:13.kjv: And there came one that had escaped, and told Abram the Hebrew; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner: and these were confederate with Abram.

bsb: and they set out in pursuit
14:14.web: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.
14:14.kjv: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his trained servants, born in his own house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued them unto Dan.

14:15.web: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.
14:15.kjv: And he divided himself against them, he and his servants, by night, and smote them, and pursued them unto Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

bsb: and the rest of the people.
14:16.web: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative, Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.
14:16.kjv: And he brought back all the goods, and also brought again his brother Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

14:17.web: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
14:17.kjv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king’s dale.

14:18.web: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.
14:18.kjv: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought forth bread and wine: and he was the priest of the most high God.

14:19.web: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:
14:19.kjv: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:

14:20.web: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.
14:20.kjv: And blessed be the most high God, which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand. And he gave him tithes of all.

14:21.web: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”
14:21.kjv: And the king of Sodom said unto Abram, Give me the persons, and take the goods to thyself.

14:22.web: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,
14:22.kjv: And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

14:23.web: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
14:23.kjv: That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet, and that I will not take any thing that is thine, lest thou shouldest say, I have made Abram rich:

14:24.web: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”
14:24.kjv: Save only that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men which went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion.

15:1.web: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
15:1.kjv: After these things the word of the LORD came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.

15:2.web: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
15:2.kjv: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?

15:3.web: Abram said, “Behold, to me you have given no children: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”
15:3.kjv: And Abram said, Behold, to me thou hast given no seed: and, lo, one born in my house is mine heir.

15:4.web: Behold, Yahweh’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”
15:4.kjv: And, behold, the word of the LORD came unto him, saying, This shall not be thine heir; but he that shall come forth out of thine own bowels shall be thine heir.

15:5.web: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So will your offspring be.”
15:5.kjv: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.

15:6.web: He believed in Yahweh, who credited it to him for righteousness.
15:6.kjv: And he believed in the LORD; and he counted it to him for righteousness.

15:7.web: He said to Abram, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”
15:7.kjv: And he said unto him, I am the LORD that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give thee this land to inherit it.

15:8.web: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”
15:8.kjv: And he said, Lord GOD, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?

15:9.web: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”
15:9.kjv: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

15:10.web: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.
15:10.kjv: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

15:11.web: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
15:11.kjv: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

15:12.web: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.
15:12.kjv: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.

15:13.web: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.
15:13.kjv: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

15:14.web: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth,
15:14.kjv: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.

15:15.web: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.
15:15.kjv: And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace; thou shalt be buried in a good old age.

15:16.web: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”
15:16.kjv: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again: for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.

15:17.web: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
15:17.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

15:18.web: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
15:18.kjv: In the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, Unto thy seed have I given this land, from the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates:

15:19.web: the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
15:19.kjv: The Kenites, and the Kenizzites, and the Kadmonites,

15:20.web: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
15:20.kjv: And the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Rephaims,

15:21.web: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
15:21.kjv: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

16:1.web: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.
16:1.kjv: Now Sarai Abram’s wife bare him no children: and she had an handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

16:2.web: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
16:2.kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, Behold now, the LORD hath restrained me from bearing: I pray thee, go in unto my maid; it may be that I may obtain children by her. And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai.

16:3.web: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.
16:3.kjv: And Sarai Abram’s wife took Hagar her maid the Egyptian, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife.

16:4.web: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.
16:4.kjv: And he went in unto Hagar, and she conceived: and when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

bsb: May the wrong done to me
she has treated me with contempt.
16:5.web: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes. Yahweh judge between me and you.”
16:5.kjv: And Sarai said unto Abram, My wrong be upon thee: I have given my maid into thy bosom; and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes: the LORD judge between me and thee.

bsb: Hagar so harshly that she fled
16:6.web: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.
16:6.kjv: But Abram said unto Sarai, Behold, thy maid is in thy hand; do to her as it pleaseth thee. And when Sarai dealt hardly with her, she fled from her face.

16:7.web: Yahweh’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
16:7.kjv: And the angel of the LORD found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

16:8.web: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”
16:8.kjv: And he said, Hagar, Sarai’s maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go? And she said, I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai.

16:9.web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”
16:9.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

16:10.web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”
16:10.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, I will multiply thy seed exceedingly, that it shall not be numbered for multitude.

16:11.web: Yahweh’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.
16:11.kjv: And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Behold, thou art with child, and shalt bear a son, and shalt call his name Ishmael; because the LORD hath heard thy affliction.

bsb: will be against everyone, and everyone’s
16:12.web: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposite all of his brothers.”
16:12.kjv: And he will be a wild man; his hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren.

bsb: seen the One who sees me!”
16:13.web: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”
16:13.kjv: And she called the name of the LORD that spake unto her, Thou God seest me: for she said, Have I also here looked after him that seeth me?

16:14.web: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
16:14.kjv: Wherefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

16:15.web: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
16:15.kjv: And Hagar bare Abram a son: and Abram called his son’s name, which Hagar bare, Ishmael.

16:16.web: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
16:16.kjv: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.

17:1.web: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.
17:1.kjv: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine, the LORD appeared to Abram, and said unto him, I am the Almighty God; walk before me, and be thou perfect.

17:2.web: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”
17:2.kjv: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.

17:3.web: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,
17:3.kjv: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,

17:4.web: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
17:4.kjv: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.

17:5.web: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
17:5.kjv: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.

17:6.web: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
17:6.kjv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.

bsb: and the God of your descendants
17:7.web: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.
17:7.kjv: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

17:8.web: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”
17:8.kjv: And I will give unto thee, and to thy seed after thee, the land wherein thou art a stranger, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession; and I will be their God.

17:9.web: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you will keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
17:9.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations.

17:10.web: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.
17:10.kjv: This is my covenant, which ye shall keep, between me and you and thy seed after thee; Every man child among you shall be circumcised.

17:11.web: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.
17:11.kjv: And ye shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin; and it shall be a token of the covenant betwixt me and you.

17:12.web: He who is eight days old will be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.
17:12.kjv: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every man child in your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.

17:13.web: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
17:13.kjv: He that is born in thy house, and he that is bought with thy money, must needs be circumcised: and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

17:14.web: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”
17:14.kjv: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.

17:15.web: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.
17:15.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, As for Sarai thy wife, thou shalt not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall her name be.

17:16.web: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”
17:16.kjv: And I will bless her, and give thee a son also of her: yea, I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of people shall be of her.

17:17.web: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
17:17.kjv: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?

17:18.web: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”
17:18.kjv: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!

17:19.web: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
17:19.kjv: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.

17:20.web: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
17:20.kjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard thee: Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly; twelve princes shall he beget, and I will make him a great nation.

17:21.web: But my covenant I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”
17:21.kjv: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.

17:22.web: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
17:22.kjv: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.

17:23.web: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money; every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.
17:23.kjv: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.

17:24.web: Abraham was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
17:24.kjv: And Abraham was ninety years old and nine, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

17:25.web: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
17:25.kjv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

17:26.web: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.
17:26.kjv: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

17:27.web: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
17:27.kjv: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

18:1.web: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
18:1.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre: and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day;

18:2.web: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood opposite him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,
18:2.kjv: And he lift up his eyes and looked, and, lo, three men stood by him: and when he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground,

18:3.web: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.
18:3.kjv: And said, My Lord, if now I have found favour in thy sight, pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant:

18:4.web: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
18:4.kjv: Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree:

bsb: you may continue on your way.” “
18:5.web: I will get a morsel of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”
18:5.kjv: And I will fetch a morsel of bread, and comfort ye your hearts; after that ye shall pass on: for therefore are ye come to your servant. And they said, So do, as thou hast said.

18:6.web: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”
18:6.kjv: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.

18:7.web: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.
18:7.kjv: And Abraham ran unto the herd, and fetcht a calf tender and good, and gave it unto a young man; and he hasted to dress it.

18:8.web: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.
18:8.kjv: And he took butter, and milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree, and they did eat.

18:9.web: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “See, in the tent.”
18:9.kjv: And they said unto him, Where is Sarah thy wife? And he said, Behold, in the tent.

18:10.web: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.
18:10.kjv: And he said, I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life; and, lo, Sarah thy wife shall have a son. And Sarah heard it in the tent door, which was behind him.

18:11.web: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
18:11.kjv: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women.

18:12.web: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
18:12.kjv: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?

18:13.web: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child, yet I am old?’
18:13.kjv: And the LORD said unto Abraham, Wherefore did Sarah laugh, saying, Shall I of a surety bear a child, which am old?

18:14.web: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have a son.”
18:14.kjv: Is any thing too hard for the LORD? At the time appointed I will return unto thee, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son.

18:15.web: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”
18:15.kjv: Then Sarah denied, saying, I laughed not; for she was afraid. And he said, Nay; but thou didst laugh.

18:16.web: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.
18:16.kjv: And the men rose up from thence, and looked toward Sodom: and Abraham went with them to bring them on the way.

18:17.web: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,
18:17.kjv: And the LORD said, Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do;

18:18.web: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?
18:18.kjv: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?

18:19.web: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”
18:19.kjv: For I know him, that he will command his children and his household after him, and they shall keep the way of the LORD, to do justice and judgment; that the LORD may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him.

18:20.web: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,
18:20.kjv: And the LORD said, Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous;

18:21.web: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”
18:21.kjv: I will go down now, and see whether they have done altogether according to the cry of it, which is come unto me; and if not, I will know.

18:22.web: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.
18:22.kjv: And the men turned their faces from thence, and went toward Sodom: but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

18:23.web: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?
18:23.kjv: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?

18:24.web: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?
18:24.kjv: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city: wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein?

18:25.web: Be it far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”
18:25.kjv: That be far from thee to do after this manner, to slay the righteous with the wicked: and that the righteous should be as the wicked, that be far from thee: Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?

18:26.web: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
18:26.kjv: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes.

18:27.web: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.
18:27.kjv: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord, which am but dust and ashes:

18:28.web: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”
18:28.kjv: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five? And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.

18:29.web: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”
18:29.kjv: And he spake unto him yet again, and said, Peradventure there shall be forty found there. And he said, I will not do it for forty’s sake.

18:30.web: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”
18:30.kjv: And he said unto him, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Peradventure there shall thirty be found there. And he said, I will not do it, if I find thirty there.

18:31.web: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”
18:31.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord: Peradventure there shall be twenty found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for twenty’s sake.

18:32.web: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”
18:32.kjv: And he said, Oh let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten’s sake.

18:33.web: Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.
18:33.kjv: And the LORD went his way, as soon as he had left communing with Abraham: and Abraham returned unto his place.

19:1.web: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,
19:1.kjv: And there came two angels to Sodom at even; and Lot sat in the gate of Sodom: and Lot seeing them rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground;

19:2.web: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”
19:2.kjv: And he said, Behold now, my lords, turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet, and ye shall rise up early, and go on your ways. And they said, Nay; but we will abide in the street all night.

19:3.web: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.
19:3.kjv: And he pressed upon them greatly; and they turned in unto him, and entered into his house; and he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.

19:4.web: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.
19:4.kjv: But before they lay down, the men of the city, even the men of Sodom, compassed the house round, both old and young, all the people from every quarter:

19:5.web: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”
19:5.kjv: And they called unto Lot, and said unto him, Where are the men which came in to thee this night? bring them out unto us, that we may know them.

19:6.web: Lot went out to them to the door, and shut the door after him.
19:6.kjv: And Lot went out at the door unto them, and shut the door after him,

19:7.web: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
19:7.kjv: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.

19:8.web: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”
19:8.kjv: Behold now, I have two daughters which have not known man; let me, I pray you, bring them out unto you, and do ye to them as is good in your eyes: only unto these men do nothing; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof.

bsb: and he is already acting like a judge!
19:9.web: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now will we deal worse with you, than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.
19:9.kjv: And they said, Stand back. And they said again, This one fellow came in to sojourn, and he will needs be a judge: now will we deal worse with thee, than with them. And they pressed sore upon the man, even Lot, and came near to break the door.

19:10.web: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.
19:10.kjv: But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

19:11.web: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.
19:11.kjv: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great: so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

19:12.web: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whoever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:
19:12.kjv: And the men said unto Lot, Hast thou here any besides? son in law, and thy sons, and thy daughters, and whatsoever thou hast in the city, bring them out of this place:

bsb: against its people is so great
19:13.web: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”
19:13.kjv: For we will destroy this place, because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the LORD; and the LORD hath sent us to destroy it.

bsb: who were pledged in marriage to
19:14.web: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city.” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.
19:14.kjv: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.

19:15.web: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife, and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
19:15.kjv: And when the morning arose, then the angels hastened Lot, saying, Arise, take thy wife, and thy two daughters, which are here; lest thou be consumed in the iniquity of the city.

19:16.web: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.
19:16.kjv: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.

bsb: As soon as the men had brought
19:17.web: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”
19:17.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had brought them forth abroad, that he said, Escape for thy life; look not behind thee, neither stay thou in all the plain; escape to the mountain, lest thou be consumed.

19:18.web: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.
19:18.kjv: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my Lord:

19:19.web: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.
19:19.kjv: Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

19:20.web: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
19:20.kjv: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.

19:21.web: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
19:21.kjv: And he said unto him, See, I have accepted thee concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow this city, for the which thou hast spoken.

19:22.web: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
19:22.kjv: Haste thee, escape thither; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither. Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

bsb: And by the time the sun
19:23.web: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
19:23.kjv: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.

19:24.web: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.
19:24.kjv: Then the LORD rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the LORD out of heaven;

19:25.web: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.
19:25.kjv: And he overthrew those cities, and all the plain, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground.

19:26.web: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
19:26.kjv: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

19:27.web: Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.
19:27.kjv: And Abraham gat up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the LORD:

19:28.web: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and looked, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.
19:28.kjv: And he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and beheld, and, lo, the smoke of the country went up as the smoke of a furnace.

19:29.web: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.
19:29.kjv: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt.

19:30.web: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.
19:30.kjv: And Lot went up out of Zoar, and dwelt in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he feared to dwell in Zoar: and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters.

19:31.web: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.
19:31.kjv: And the firstborn said unto the younger, Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us after the manner of all the earth:

19:32.web: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
19:32.kjv: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

19:33.web: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.
19:33.kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

19:34.web: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine again, tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
19:34.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the firstborn said unto the younger, Behold, I lay yesternight with my father: let us make him drink wine this night also; and go thou in, and lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.

19:35.web: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.
19:35.kjv: And they made their father drink wine that night also: and the younger arose, and lay with him; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.

19:36.web: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.
19:36.kjv: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father.

19:37.web: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
19:37.kjv: And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.

19:38.web: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
19:38.kjv: And the younger, she also bare a son, and called his name Benammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.

20:1.web: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.
20:1.kjv: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

20:2.web: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
20:2.kjv: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

bsb: You are as good as dead
20:3.web: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken. For she is a man’s wife.”
20:3.kjv: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man’s wife.

20:4.web: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?
20:4.kjv: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

20:5.web: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister?’ She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this.”
20:5.kjv: Said he not unto me, She is my sister? and she, even she herself said, He is my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this.

20:6.web: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.
20:6.kjv: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

20:7.web: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”
20:7.kjv: Now therefore restore the man his wife; for he is a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore her not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that are thine.

bsb: and when he described to them
20:8.web: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.
20:8.kjv: Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

20:9.web: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”
20:9.kjv: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

20:10.web: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”
20:10.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

20:11.web: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
20:11.kjv: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife’s sake.

20:12.web: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
20:12.kjv: And yet indeed she is my sister; she is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

20:13.web: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”
20:13.kjv: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said unto her, This is thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He is my brother.

20:14.web: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.
20:14.kjv: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

20:15.web: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”
20:15.kjv: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee.

20:16.web: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”
20:16.kjv: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver: behold, he is to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that are with thee, and with all other: thus she was reproved.

bsb: so that they could again bear children—
20:17.web: Abraham prayed to God. God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.
20:17.kjv: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare children.

20:18.web: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
20:18.kjv: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham’s wife.

21:1.web: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.
21:1.kjv: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.

21:2.web: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
21:2.kjv: For Sarah conceived, and bare Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

21:3.web: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
21:3.kjv: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

21:4.web: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
21:4.kjv: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.

21:5.web: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
21:5.kjv: And Abraham was an hundred years old, when his son Isaac was born unto him.

21:6.web: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
21:6.kjv: And Sarah said, God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

21:7.web: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”
21:7.kjv: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

21:8.web: The child grew, and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
21:8.kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

21:9.web: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.
21:9.kjv: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

21:10.web: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
21:10.kjv: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

21:11.web: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.
21:11.kjv: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.

21:12.web: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.
21:12.kjv: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

21:13.web: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”
21:13.kjv: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation, because he is thy seed.

bsb: and sent her away with the boy.
21:14.web: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
21:14.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave it unto Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beer-sheba.

21:15.web: The water in the bottle was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.
21:15.kjv: And the water was spent in the bottle, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

21:16.web: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.
21:16.kjv: And she went, and sat her down over against him a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against him, and lift up her voice, and wept.

21:17.web: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What ails you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
21:17.kjv: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is.

21:18.web: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him in your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”
21:18.kjv: Arise, lift up the lad, and hold him in thine hand; for I will make him a great nation.

21:19.web: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the bottle with water, and gave the boy drink.
21:19.kjv: And God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went, and filled the bottle with water, and gave the lad drink.

21:20.web: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.
21:20.kjv: And God was with the lad; and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.

21:21.web: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.
21:21.kjv: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran: and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt.

21:22.web: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.
21:22.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God is with thee in all that thou doest:

21:23.web: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”
21:23.kjv: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

21:24.kjv: And Abraham said, I will swear.

21:25.web: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.
21:25.kjv: And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

21:26.web: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”
21:26.kjv: And Abimelech said, I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.

21:27.web: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.
21:27.kjv: And Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them unto Abimelech; and both of them made a covenant.

21:28.web: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
21:28.kjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

21:29.web: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves mean?”
21:29.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

21:30.web: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
21:30.kjv: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.

21:31.web: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.
21:31.kjv: Wherefore he called that place Beer-sheba; because there they sware both of them.

21:32.web: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.
21:32.kjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beer-sheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

21:33.web: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and called there on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.
21:33.kjv: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer-sheba, and called there on the name of the LORD, the everlasting God.

21:34.web: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.
21:34.kjv: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.

22:1.web: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
22:1.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that God did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

22:2.web: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”
22:2.kjv: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only son Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

22:3.web: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
22:3.kjv: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

22:4.web: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.
22:4.kjv: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place afar off.

22:5.web: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go yonder. We will worship, and come back to you.”
22:5.kjv: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you,

22:6.web: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.
22:6.kjv: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

22:7.web: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”
22:7.kjv: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?

22:8.web: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.
22:8.kjv: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.

22:9.web: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.
22:9.kjv: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

22:10.web: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.
22:10.kjv: And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

22:11.web: Yahweh’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”
22:11.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto him out of heaven, and said, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.

22:12.web: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”
22:12.kjv: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only son from me.

22:13.web: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
22:13.kjv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

22:14.web: Abraham called the name of that place Yahweh Will Provide. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”
22:14.kjv: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah-jireh: as it is said to this day, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen.

22:15.web: Yahweh’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,
22:15.kjv: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time,

22:16.web: and said, “I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,
22:16.kjv: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son:

22:17.web: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.
22:17.kjv: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

22:18.web: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.”
22:18.kjv: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.

22:19.web: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.
22:19.kjv: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beer-sheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beer-sheba.

22:20.web: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
22:20.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;

22:21.web: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,
22:21.kjv: Huz his firstborn, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel the father of Aram,

22:22.web: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
22:22.kjv: And Chesed, and Hazo, and Pildash, and Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

22:23.web: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.
22:23.kjv: And Bethuel begat Rebekah: these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

22:24.web: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
22:24.kjv: And his concubine, whose name was Reumah, she bare also Tebah, and Gaham, and Thahash, and Maachah.

23:1.web: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.
23:1.kjv: And Sarah was an hundred and seven and twenty years old: these were the years of the life of Sarah.

23:2.web: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.
23:2.kjv: And Sarah died in Kirjath-arba; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan: and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

23:3.web: Abraham rose up from before his dead, and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,
23:3.kjv: And Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spake unto the sons of Heth, saying,

23:4.web: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”
23:4.kjv: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.

23:5.web: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
23:5.kjv: And the children of Heth answered Abraham, saying unto him,

23:6.web: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”
23:6.kjv: Hear us, my lord: thou art a mighty prince among us: in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre, but that thou mayest bury thy dead.

23:7.web: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
23:7.kjv: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.

23:8.web: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,
23:8.kjv: And he communed with them, saying, If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight; hear me, and intreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

bsb: so that I may have a burial
23:9.web: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him give it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”
23:9.kjv: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.

23:10.web: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,
23:10.kjv: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the audience of the children of Heth, even of all that went in at the gate of his city, saying,

23:11.web: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”
23:11.kjv: Nay, my lord, hear me: the field give I thee, and the cave that is therein, I give it thee; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee: bury thy dead.

23:12.web: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.
23:12.kjv: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land.

23:13.web: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”
23:13.kjv: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, But if thou wilt give it, I pray thee, hear me: I will give thee money for the field; take it of me, and I will bury my dead there.

23:14.web: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
23:14.kjv: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,

23:15.web: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”
23:15.kjv: My lord, hearken unto me: the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver; what is that betwixt me and thee? bury therefore thy dead.

23:16.web: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the audience of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.
23:16.kjv: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

23:17.web: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded
23:17.kjv: And the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure

23:18.web: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.
23:18.kjv: Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.

23:19.web: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
23:19.kjv: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre: the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan.

23:20.web: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.
23:20.kjv: And the field, and the cave that is therein, were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth.

24:1.web: Abraham was old, and well stricken in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.
24:1.kjv: And Abraham was old, and well stricken in age: and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

24:2.web: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.
24:2.kjv: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had, Put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh:

bsb: and I will have you swear
24:3.web: I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.
24:3.kjv: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth, that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell:

24:4.web: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”
24:4.kjv: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.

bsb: Shall I then take your son back
24:5.web: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”
24:5.kjv: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?

24:6.web: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.
