24:6.kjv: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.

24:7.web: Yahweh, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring. He will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
24:7.kjv: The LORD God of heaven, which took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my kindred, and which spake unto me, and that sware unto me, saying, Unto thy seed will I give this land; he shall send his angel before thee, and thou shalt take a wife unto my son from thence.

24:8.web: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”
24:8.kjv: And if the woman will not be willing to follow thee, then thou shalt be clear from this my oath: only bring not my son thither again.

24:9.web: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
24:9.kjv: And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and sware to him concerning that matter.

24:10.web: The servant took ten camels, of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
24:10.kjv: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master, and departed; for all the goods of his master were in his hand: and he arose, and went to Mesopotamia, unto the city of Nahor.

24:11.web: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.
24:11.kjv: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening, even the time that women go out to draw water.

24:12.web: He said, “Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
24:12.kjv: And he said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, I pray thee, send me good speed this day, and shew kindness unto my master Abraham.

24:13.web: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
24:13.kjv: Behold, I stand here by the well of water; and the daughters of the men of the city come out to draw water:

bsb: let her be the one You have appointed
24:14.web: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ and she will say, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”
24:14.kjv: And let it come to pass, that the damsel to whom I shall say, Let down thy pitcher, I pray thee, that I may drink; and she shall say, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: let the same be she that thou hast appointed for thy servant Isaac; and thereby shall I know that thou hast shewed kindness unto my master.

24:15.web: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.
24:15.kjv: And it came to pass, before he had done speaking, that, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher upon her shoulder.

24:16.web: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.
24:16.kjv: And the damsel was very fair to look upon, a virgin, neither had any man known her: and she went down to the well, and filled her pitcher, and came up.

24:17.web: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”
24:17.kjv: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.

24:18.web: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.
24:18.kjv: And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

24:19.web: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”
24:19.kjv: And when she had done giving him drink, she said, I will draw water for thy camels also, until they have done drinking.

bsb: to draw water, until she had drawn water
24:20.web: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.
24:20.kjv: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.

24:21.web: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether Yahweh had made his journey prosperous or not.
24:21.kjv: And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

24:22.web: As the camels had done drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,
24:22.kjv: And it came to pass, as the camels had done drinking, that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold;

24:23.web: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”
24:23.kjv: And said, Whose daughter art thou? tell me, I pray thee: is there room in thy father’s house for us to lodge in?

24:24.web: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”
24:24.kjv: And she said unto him, I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, which she bare unto Nahor.

24:25.web: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”
24:25.kjv: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.

24:26.web: The man bowed his head, and worshiped Yahweh.
24:26.kjv: And the man bowed down his head, and worshipped the LORD.

24:27.web: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, Yahweh has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”
24:27.kjv: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master’s brethren.

24:28.web: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.
24:28.kjv: And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.

24:29.web: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.
24:29.kjv: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.

24:30.web: When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
24:30.kjv: And it came to pass, when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, Thus spake the man unto me; that he came unto the man; and, behold, he stood by the camels at the well.

24:31.web: He said, “Come in, you blessed of Yahweh. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”
24:31.kjv: And he said, Come in, thou blessed of the LORD; wherefore standest thou without? for I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.

24:32.web: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
24:32.kjv: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.

24:33.web: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” He said, “Speak on.”
24:33.kjv: And there was set meat before him to eat: but he said, I will not eat, until I have told mine errand. And he said, Speak on.

24:34.kjv: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.

24:35.web: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
24:35.kjv: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.

24:36.web: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.
24:36.kjv: And Sarah my master’s wife bare a son to my master when she was old: and unto him hath he given all that he hath.

24:37.web: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
24:37.kjv: And my master made me swear, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife to my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell:

24:38.web: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
24:38.kjv: But thou shalt go unto my father’s house, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son.

24:39.web: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’
24:39.kjv: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.

24:40.web: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.
24:40.kjv: And he said unto me, The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with thee, and prosper thy way; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred, and of my father’s house:

24:41.web: Then will you be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’
24:41.kjv: Then shalt thou be clear from this my oath, when thou comest to my kindred; and if they give not thee one, thou shalt be clear from my oath.

24:42.web: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—
24:42.kjv: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go;

24:43.web: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”
24:43.kjv: Behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass, that when the virgin cometh forth to draw water, and I say to her, Give me, I pray thee, a little water of thy pitcher to drink;

24:44.web: and she will tell me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom Yahweh has appointed for my master’s son.’
24:44.kjv: And she say to me, Both drink thou, and I will also draw for thy camels: let the same be the woman whom the LORD hath appointed out for my master’s son.

24:45.web: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’
24:45.kjv: And before I had done speaking in mine heart, behold, Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down unto the well, and drew water: and I said unto her, Let me drink, I pray thee.

24:46.web: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.
24:46.kjv: And she made haste, and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, Drink, and I will give thy camels drink also: so I drank, and she made the camels drink also.

24:47.web: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.
24:47.kjv: And I asked her, and said, Whose daughter art thou? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bare unto him: and I put the earring upon her face, and the bracelets upon her hands.

24:48.web: I bowed my head, and worshiped Yahweh, and blessed Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.
24:48.kjv: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.

24:49.web: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”
24:49.kjv: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me: and if not, tell me; that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.

24:50.web: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from Yahweh. We can’t speak to you bad or good.
24:50.kjv: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, The thing proceedeth from the LORD: we cannot speak unto thee bad or good.

24:51.web: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as Yahweh has spoken.”
24:51.kjv: Behold, Rebekah is before thee, take her, and go, and let her be thy master’s son’s wife, as the LORD hath spoken.

24:52.web: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.
24:52.kjv: And it came to pass, that, when Abraham’s servant heard their words, he worshipped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.

24:53.web: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.
24:53.kjv: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment, and gave them to Rebekah: he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things.

24:54.web: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”
24:54.kjv: And they did eat and drink, he and the men that were with him, and tarried all night; and they rose up in the morning, and he said, Send me away unto my master.

24:55.web: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”
24:55.kjv: And her brother and her mother said, Let the damsel abide with us a few days, at the least ten; after that she shall go.

24:56.web: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since Yahweh has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”
24:56.kjv: And he said unto them, Hinder me not, seeing the LORD hath prospered my way; send me away that I may go to my master.

24:57.web: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”
24:57.kjv: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.

24:58.web: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”
24:58.kjv: And they called Rebekah, and said unto her, Wilt thou go with this man? And she said, I will go.

24:59.web: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.
24:59.kjv: And they sent away Rebekah their sister, and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant, and his men.

24:60.web: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”
24:60.kjv: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

24:61.web: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.
24:61.kjv: And Rebekah arose, and her damsels, and they rode upon the camels, and followed the man: and the servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

24:62.web: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.
24:62.kjv: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai-roi; for he dwelt in the south country.

24:63.web: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.
24:63.kjv: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide: and he lifted up his eyes, and saw, and, behold, the camels were coming.

24:64.web: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.
24:64.kjv: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.

24:65.web: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.
24:65.kjv: For she had said unto the servant, What man is this that walketh in the field to meet us? And the servant had said, It is my master: therefore she took a vail, and covered herself.

24:66.web: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
24:66.kjv: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.

24:67.web: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
24:67.kjv: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife; and he loved her: and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

25:1.web: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
25:1.kjv: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

25:2.web: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
25:2.kjv: And she bare him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

25:3.web: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
25:3.kjv: And Jokshan begat Sheba, and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, and Letushim, and Leummim.

25:4.web: The sons of Midian were: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
25:4.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Hanoch, and Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

25:5.web: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,
25:5.kjv: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

25:6.web: but to the sons of Abraham’s concubines, Abraham gave gifts. He sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, to the east country.
25:6.kjv: But unto the sons of the concubines, which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, eastward, unto the east country.

25:7.web: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
25:7.kjv: And these are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived, an hundred threescore and fifteen years.

25:8.web: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
25:8.kjv: Then Abraham gave up the ghost, and died in a good old age, an old man, and full of years; and was gathered to his people.

25:9.web: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre,
25:9.kjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;

25:10.web: the field which Abraham purchased of the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.
25:10.kjv: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

25:11.web: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
25:11.kjv: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai-roi.

25:12.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.
25:12.kjv: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s handmaid, bare unto Abraham:

bsb: in the order of their birth:
25:13.web: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
25:13.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

25:14.kjv: And Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

25:15.web: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
25:15.kjv: Hadar, and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

25:16.web: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.
25:16.kjv: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their towns, and by their castles; twelve princes according to their nations.

25:17.web: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.
25:17.kjv: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael, an hundred and thirty and seven years: and he gave up the ghost and died; and was gathered unto his people.

25:18.web: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.
25:18.kjv: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur, that is before Egypt, as thou goest toward Assyria: and he died in the presence of all his brethren.

25:19.web: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.
25:19.kjv: And these are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham begat Isaac:

25:20.web: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.
25:20.kjv: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

25:21.web: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
25:21.kjv: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

25:22.web: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is so, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.
25:22.kjv: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.

25:23.web: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”
25:23.kjv: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

25:24.web: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
25:24.kjv: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

25:25.web: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.
25:25.kjv: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.

25:26.web: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
25:26.kjv: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac was threescore years old when she bare them.

25:27.web: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
25:27.kjv: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob was a plain man, dwelling in tents.

25:28.web: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.
25:28.kjv: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.

25:29.web: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.
25:29.kjv: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:

25:30.web: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.
25:30.kjv: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

25:31.web: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”
25:31.kjv: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.

25:32.web: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”
25:32.kjv: And Esau said, Behold, I am at the point to die: and what profit shall this birthright do to me?

25:33.web: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.
25:33.kjv: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day; and he sware unto him: and he sold his birthright unto Jacob.

25:34.web: Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
25:34.kjv: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

26:1.web: There was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.
26:1.kjv: And there was a famine in the land, beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar.

26:2.web: Yahweh appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.
26:2.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of:

26:3.web: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
26:3.kjv: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

26:4.web: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring will all the nations of the earth be blessed,
26:4.kjv: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

26:5.web: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”
26:5.kjv: Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.

26:7.web: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”
26:7.kjv: And the men of the place asked him of his wife; and he said, She is my sister: for he feared to say, She is my wife; lest, said he, the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she was fair to look upon.

26:8.web: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.
26:8.kjv: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.

26:9.web: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister?’” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”
26:9.kjv: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she is thy wife: and how saidst thou, She is my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

26:10.web: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”
26:10.kjv: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

bsb: will surely be put to death.”
26:11.web: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”
26:11.kjv: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that toucheth this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

26:12.web: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.
26:12.kjv: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.

26:13.web: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
26:13.kjv: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:

26:14.web: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.
26:14.kjv: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

26:15.web: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.
26:15.kjv: For all the wells which his father’s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them, and filled them with earth.

26:16.web: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”
26:16.kjv: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

26:17.web: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.
26:17.kjv: And Isaac departed thence, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.

26:18.web: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father. For the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
26:18.kjv: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

26:19.web: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.
26:19.kjv: And Isaac’s servants digged in the valley, and found there a well of springing water.

26:20.web: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” He called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
26:20.kjv: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac’s herdmen, saying, The water is ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

26:21.web: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. He called its name Sitnah.
26:21.kjv: And they digged another well, and strove for that also: and he called the name of it Sitnah.

26:22.web: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. He called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now Yahweh has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”
26:22.kjv: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

26:23.web: He went up from there to Beersheba.
26:23.kjv: And he went up from thence to Beer-sheba.

26:24.web: Yahweh appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”
26:24.kjv: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham’s sake.

26:25.web: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.
26:25.kjv: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac’s servants digged a well.

26:26.web: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.
26:26.kjv: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

26:27.web: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”
26:27.kjv: And Isaac said unto them, Wherefore come ye to me, seeing ye hate me, and have sent me away from you?

26:28.web: They said, “We saw plainly that Yahweh was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let us make a covenant with you,
26:28.kjv: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with thee: and we said, Let there be now an oath betwixt us, even betwixt us and thee, and let us make a covenant with thee;

26:29.web: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of Yahweh.”
26:29.kjv: That thou wilt do us no hurt, as we have not touched thee, and as we have done unto thee nothing but good, and have sent thee away in peace: thou art now the blessed of the LORD.

26:30.web: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
26:30.kjv: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

26:31.web: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
26:31.kjv: And they rose up betimes in the morning, and sware one to another: and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

26:32.web: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”
26:32.kjv: And it came to pass the same day, that Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had digged, and said unto him, We have found water.

26:33.web: He called it Shibah. Therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.
26:33.kjv: And he called it Shebah: therefore the name of the city is Beer-sheba unto this day.

26:34.web: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
26:34.kjv: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite:

26:35.web: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
26:35.kjv: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.

bsb: that he could no longer see,
27:1.web: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”
27:1.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.

27:2.web: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.
27:2.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:

27:3.web: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison.
27:3.kjv: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;

27:4.web: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
27:4.kjv: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.

27:5.web: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
27:5.kjv: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

27:6.web: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,
27:6.kjv: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,

bsb: so that I may bless you
27:7.web: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’
27:7.kjv: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

27:8.web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.
27:8.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.

27:9.web: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.
27:9.kjv: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:

27:10.web: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”
27:10.kjv: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.

27:11.web: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
27:11.kjv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

27:12.web: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”
27:12.kjv: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.

27:13.web: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
27:13.kjv: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.

27:14.web: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
27:14.kjv: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.

27:15.web: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
27:15.kjv: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:

27:16.web: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
27:16.kjv: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:

27:17.web: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
27:17.kjv: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

27:18.web: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”
27:18.kjv: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?

27:19.web: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”
27:19.kjv: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.

27:20.web: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because Yahweh your God gave me success.”
27:20.kjv: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the LORD thy God brought it to me.

27:21.web: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
27:21.kjv: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.

bsb: but the hands are the hands
27:22.web: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
27:22.kjv: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.

27:23.web: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother, Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
27:23.kjv: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.

27:24.web: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”
27:24.kjv: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.

27:25.web: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.
27:25.kjv: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.

27:26.web: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
27:26.kjv: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.

27:27.web: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Yahweh has blessed.
27:27.kjv: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD hath blessed:

27:28.web: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
27:28.kjv: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:

bsb: May those who curse you be cursed,
and those who bless you be blessed.”
27:29.web: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”
27:29.kjv: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.

27:30.web: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
27:30.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

27:31.web: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”
27:31.kjv: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.

27:32.web: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
27:32.kjv: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.

27:33.web: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”
27:33.kjv: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.

27:34.web: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”
27:34.kjv: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.

27:35.web: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”
27:35.kjv: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.

27:36.web: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”
27:36.kjv: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

bsb: that I can do for you,
27:37.web: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”
27:37.kjv: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?

27:38.web: Esau said to his father, “Have you but one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
27:38.kjv: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

27:39.web: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, of the fatness of the earth will be your dwelling, and of the dew of the sky from above.
27:39.kjv: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;

27:40.web: By your sword will you live, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you shall shake his yoke from off your neck.”
27:40.kjv: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.

27:41.web: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
27:41.kjv: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.

27:42.web: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
27:42.kjv: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.

27:43.web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
27:43.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;

27:44.web: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away;
27:44.kjv: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;

bsb: Then I will send for you
27:45.web: until your brother’s anger turn away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”
27:45.kjv: Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?

27:46.web: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”
27:46.kjv: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?

28:1.web: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
28:1.kjv: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

28:2.web: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
28:2.kjv: Arise, go to Padan-aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother’s father; and take thee a wife from thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother’s brother.

28:3.web: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,
28:3.kjv: And God Almighty bless thee, and make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, that thou mayest be a multitude of people;

bsb: where you dwell as a foreigner,
28:4.web: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you, and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”
28:4.kjv: And give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee, and to thy seed with thee; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger, which God gave unto Abraham.

28:5.web: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, Rebekah’s brother, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
28:5.kjv: And Isaac sent away Jacob: and he went to Padan-aram unto Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

28:6.web: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan,”
28:6.kjv: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-aram, to take him a wife from thence; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

28:7.web: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.
28:7.kjv: And that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-aram;

28:8.web: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.
28:8.kjv: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father;

28:9.web: Esau went to Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.
28:9.kjv: Then went Esau unto Ishmael, and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife.

28:10.web: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
28:10.kjv: And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went toward Haran.

28:11.web: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.
28:11.kjv: And he lighted upon a certain place, and tarried there all night, because the sun was set; and he took of the stones of that place, and put them for his pillows, and lay down in that place to sleep.

28:12.web: He dreamed. Behold, a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
28:12.kjv: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

28:13.web: Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. The land whereon you lie, to you will I give it, and to your offspring.
28:13.kjv: And, behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, I am the LORD God of Abraham thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land whereon thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed;

28:14.web: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring will all the families of the earth be blessed.
28:14.kjv: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

bsb: and I will watch over you
and I will bring you back
28:15.web: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you, until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
28:15.kjv: And, behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of.

28:16.web: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely Yahweh is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”
28:16.kjv: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.

28:17.web: He was afraid, and said, “How dreadful is this place! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”
28:17.kjv: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

28:18.web: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.
28:18.kjv: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.

28:19.web: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
28:19.kjv: And he called the name of that place Bethel: but the name of that city was called Luz at the first.

28:20.web: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,
28:20.kjv: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,

28:21.web: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and Yahweh will be my God,
28:21.kjv: So that I come again to my father’s house in peace; then shall the LORD be my God:

bsb: I will surely give You a tenth.”
28:22.web: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”
28:22.kjv: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be God’s house: and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.

29:1.web: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.
29:1.kjv: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came into the land of the people of the east.

29:2.web: He looked, and behold, a well in the field, and, behold, three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.
29:2.kjv: And he looked, and behold a well in the field, and, lo, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks: and a great stone was upon the well’s mouth.

29:3.web: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again on the well’s mouth in its place.
29:3.kjv: And thither were all the flocks gathered: and they rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone again upon the well’s mouth in his place.

29:4.web: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”
29:4.kjv: And Jacob said unto them, My brethren, whence be ye? And they said, Of Haran are we.

29:5.web: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”
29:5.kjv: And he said unto them, Know ye Laban the son of Nahor? And they said, We know him.

29:6.web: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”
29:6.kjv: And he said unto them, Is he well? And they said, He is well: and, behold, Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep.

29:7.web: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”
29:7.kjv: And he said, Lo, it is yet high day, neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together: water ye the sheep, and go and feed them.

29:8.web: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we water the sheep.”
29:8.kjv: And they said, We cannot, until all the flocks be gathered together, and till they roll the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep.

29:9.web: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
29:9.kjv: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep: for she kept them.

29:10.web: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
29:10.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

29:11.web: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.
29:11.kjv: And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

29:12.web: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.
29:12.kjv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s brother, and that he was Rebekah’s son: and she ran and told her father.

29:13.web: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.
29:13.kjv: And it came to pass, when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. And he told Laban all these things.

29:14.web: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” He stayed with him for a month.
29:14.kjv: And Laban said to him, Surely thou art my bone and my flesh. And he abode with him the space of a month.

29:15.web: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my brother, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”
29:15.kjv: And Laban said unto Jacob, Because thou art my brother, shouldest thou therefore serve me for nought? tell me, what shall thy wages be?

29:16.web: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
29:16.kjv: And Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

29:17.web: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.
29:17.kjv: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.

29:18.web: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”
29:18.kjv: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.

29:19.web: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”
29:19.kjv: And Laban said, It is better that I give her to thee, than that I should give her to another man: abide with me.

29:20.web: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.
29:20.kjv: And Jacob served seven years for Rachel; and they seemed unto him but a few days, for the love he had to her.

bsb: and I want to sleep with
29:21.web: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”
29:21.kjv: And Jacob said unto Laban, Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.

29:22.web: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.
29:22.kjv: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

29:23.web: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him. He went in to her.
29:23.kjv: And it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to him; and he went in unto her.

29:24.web: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.
29:24.kjv: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

29:25.web: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”
29:25.kjv: And it came to pass, that in the morning, behold, it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What is this thou hast done unto me? did not I serve with thee for Rachel? wherefore then hast thou beguiled me?

29:26.web: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.
29:26.kjv: And Laban said, It must not be so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.

29:27.web: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me yet seven other years.”
29:27.kjv: Fulfil her week, and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years.

29:28.web: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.
29:28.kjv: And Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week: and he gave him Rachel his daughter to wife also.

29:29.web: Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah, his servant, to be her servant.
29:29.kjv: And Laban gave to Rachel his daughter Bilhah his handmaid to be her maid.

29:30.web: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.
29:30.kjv: And he went in also unto Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him yet seven other years.

29:31.web: Yahweh saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
29:31.kjv: And when the LORD saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb: but Rachel was barren.

29:32.web: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because Yahweh has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”
29:32.kjv: And Leah conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Reuben: for she said, Surely the LORD hath looked upon my affliction; now therefore my husband will love me.

29:33.web: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because Yahweh has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.
29:33.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Because the LORD hath heard that I was hated, he hath therefore given me this son also: and she called his name Simeon.

29:34.web: She conceived again, and bore a son. Said, “Now this time will my husband be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.
29:34.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and said, Now this time will my husband be joined unto me, because I have born him three sons: therefore was his name called Levi.

29:35.web: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time will I praise Yahweh.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
29:35.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise the LORD: therefore she called his name Judah; and left bearing.

30:1.web: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”
30:1.kjv: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.

30:2.web: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”
30:2.kjv: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?

30:3.web: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”
30:3.kjv: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees that I may also have children by her.

30:4.web: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
30:4.kjv: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.

30:5.web: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.
30:5.kjv: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

30:6.web: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore called she his name Dan.
30:6.kjv: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.

30:7.web: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.
30:7.kjv: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

30:8.web: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.
30:8.kjv: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

30:9.web: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
30:9.kjv: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.

30:10.web: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.
30:10.kjv: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.

30:11.web: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.
30:11.kjv: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.

30:12.web: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.
30:12.kjv: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

30:13.web: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
30:13.kjv: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.

30:14.web: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”
30:14.kjv: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

30:15.web: She said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”
30:15.kjv: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.

30:16.web: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.
30:16.kjv: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.

30:17.web: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.
30:17.kjv: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.

30:18.web: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
30:18.kjv: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

30:19.web: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
30:19.kjv: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.

30:20.web: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.
30:20.kjv: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.

30:21.web: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.
30:21.kjv: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.

30:22.web: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.
30:22.kjv: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

30:23.web: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”
30:23.kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:

30:24.web: She named him Joseph, saying, “May Yahweh add another son to me.”
30:24.kjv: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.

30:25.web: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.
30:25.kjv: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.

bsb: that I may go on my way.
30:26.web: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”
30:26.kjv: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.

30:27.web: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake.”
30:27.kjv: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.

30:28.web: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”
30:28.kjv: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.

30:29.web: He said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.
30:29.kjv: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.

30:30.web: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. Yahweh has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”
30:30.kjv: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?

30:31.web: He said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.
30:31.kjv: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:

30:32.web: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.
30:32.kjv: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.

30:33.web: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”
30:33.kjv: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.

30:34.web: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”
30:34.kjv: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.

30:35.web: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
30:35.kjv: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

30:36.web: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
30:36.kjv: And he set three days journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

30:37.web: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
30:37.kjv: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

30:38.web: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the gutters in the watering-troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.
30:38.kjv: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

30:39.web: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.
30:39.kjv: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.

30:40.web: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in the flock of Laban: and he put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.
30:40.kjv: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.

30:41.web: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods;
30:41.kjv: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

30:42.web: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
30:42.kjv: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

30:43.web: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
30:43.kjv: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.

31:1.web: He heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”
31:1.kjv: And he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob hath taken away all that was our father’s; and of that which was our father’s hath he gotten all this glory.

31:2.web: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.
31:2.kjv: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

31:3.web: Yahweh said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”
31:3.kjv: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.

31:4.web: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,
31:4.kjv: And Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field unto his flock,

31:5.web: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
31:5.kjv: And said unto them, I see your father’s countenance, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father hath been with me.

31:6.web: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.
31:6.kjv: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father.

31:7.web: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.
31:7.kjv: And your father hath deceived me, and changed my wages ten times; but God suffered him not to hurt me.

31:8.web: If he said this, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said this, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.
31:8.kjv: If he said thus, The speckled shall be thy wages; then all the cattle bare speckled: and if he said thus, The ringstraked shall be thy hire; then bare all the cattle ringstraked.

31:9.web: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.
31:9.kjv: Thus God hath taken away the cattle of your father, and given them to me.

31:10.web: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.
31:10.kjv: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived, that I lifted up mine eyes, and saw in a dream, and, behold, the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked, speckled, and grisled.

31:11.web: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’
31:11.kjv: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream, saying, Jacob: And I said, Here am I.

31:12.web: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.
31:12.kjv: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

31:13.web: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”
31:13.kjv: I am the God of Bethel, where thou anointedst the pillar, and where thou vowedst a vow unto me: now arise, get thee out from this land, and return unto the land of thy kindred.

31:14.web: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
31:14.kjv: And Rachel and Leah answered and said unto him, Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

31:15.web: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.
31:15.kjv: Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.
