31:16.web: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father, that is ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”
31:16.kjv: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father, that is ours, and our children’s: now then, whatsoever God hath said unto thee, do.

31:17.web: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,
31:17.kjv: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives upon camels;

31:18.web: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.
31:18.kjv: And he carried away all his cattle, and all his goods which he had gotten, the cattle of his getting, which he had gotten in Padan-aram, for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.

31:19.web: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep: and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.
31:19.kjv: And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.

31:20.web: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.
31:20.kjv: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.

31:21.web: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.
31:21.kjv: So he fled with all that he had; and he rose up, and passed over the river, and set his face toward the mount Gilead.

31:22.web: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
31:22.kjv: And it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob was fled.

31:23.web: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
31:23.kjv: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days’ journey; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead.

31:24.web: God came to Laban, the Syrian, in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”
31:24.kjv: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

31:25.web: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.
31:25.kjv: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.

31:26.web: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?
31:26.kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?

bsb: I would have sent you away
31:27.web: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;
31:27.kjv: Wherefore didst thou flee away secretly, and steal away from me; and didst not tell me, that I might have sent thee away with mirth, and with songs, with tabret, and with harp?

31:28.web: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now have you done foolishly.
31:28.kjv: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing.

31:29.web: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’
31:29.kjv: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

31:30.web: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”
31:30.kjv: And now, though thou wouldest needs be gone, because thou sore longedst after thy father’s house, yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods?

31:31.web: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’
31:31.kjv: And Jacob answered and said to Laban, Because I was afraid: for I said, Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me.

31:32.web: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.
31:32.kjv: With whomsoever thou findest thy gods, let him not live: before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me, and take it to thee. For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them.

31:33.web: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.
31:33.kjv: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the two maidservants’ tents; but he found them not. Then went he out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

31:34.web: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.
31:34.kjv: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel’s furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.

31:35.web: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.
31:35.kjv: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.

31:36.web: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?
31:36.kjv: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

31:37.web: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.
31:37.kjv: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.

31:38.web: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.
31:38.kjv: This twenty years have I been with thee; thy ewes and thy she goats have not cast their young, and the rams of thy flock have I not eaten.

31:39.web: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
31:39.kjv: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee; I bare the loss of it; of my hand didst thou require it, whether stolen by day, or stolen by night.

31:40.web: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
31:40.kjv: Thus I was; in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep departed from mine eyes.

31:41.web: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
31:41.kjv: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters, and six years for thy cattle: and thou hast changed my wages ten times.

bsb: you would have sent me away
31:42.web: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”
31:42.kjv: Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

bsb: and these flocks are my flocks!
31:43.web: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine: and what can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?
31:43.kjv: And Laban answered and said unto Jacob, These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and these cattle are my cattle, and all that thou seest is mine: and what can I do this day unto these my daughters, or unto their children which they have born?

31:44.web: Now come, let us make a covenant, you and I; and let it be for a witness between me and you.”
31:44.kjv: Now therefore come thou, let us make a covenant, I and thou; and let it be for a witness between me and thee.

31:45.web: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
31:45.kjv: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

31:46.web: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.
31:46.kjv: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.

31:47.web: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
31:47.kjv: And Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.

31:48.web: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed
31:48.kjv: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

31:49.web: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.
31:49.kjv: And Mizpah; for he said, The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.

31:50.web: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives besides my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”
31:50.kjv: If thou shalt afflict my daughters, or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters, no man is with us; see, God is witness betwixt me and thee.

31:51.web: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.
31:51.kjv: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee;

31:52.web: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
31:52.kjv: This heap be witness, and this pillar be witness, that I will not pass over this heap to thee, and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me, for harm.

31:53.web: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.
31:53.kjv: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge betwixt us. And Jacob sware by the fear of his father Isaac.

31:54.web: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.
31:54.kjv: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount, and called his brethren to eat bread: and they did eat bread, and tarried all night in the mount.

31:55.web: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.
31:55.kjv: And early in the morning Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them: and Laban departed, and returned unto his place.

32:1.web: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
32:1.kjv: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

32:2.web: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.
32:2.kjv: And when Jacob saw them, he said, This is God’s host: and he called the name of that place Mahanaim.

32:3.web: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.
32:3.kjv: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

32:4.web: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.
32:4.kjv: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau; Thy servant Jacob saith thus, I have sojourned with Laban, and stayed there until now:

32:5.web: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”
32:5.kjv: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.

32:6.web: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. Not only that, but he comes to meet you, and four hundred men with him.”
32:6.kjv: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, We came to thy brother Esau, and also he cometh to meet thee, and four hundred men with him.

32:7.web: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, and the flocks, and the herds, and the camels, into two companies;
32:7.kjv: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed: and he divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and herds, and the camels, into two bands;

32:8.web: and he said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”
32:8.kjv: And said, If Esau come to the one company, and smite it, then the other company which is left shall escape.

bsb: and I will make you prosper,
32:9.web: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, Yahweh, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’
32:9.kjv: And Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD which saidst unto me, Return unto thy country, and to thy kindred, and I will deal well with thee:

32:10.web: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.
32:10.kjv: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan; and now I am become two bands.

32:11.web: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he come and strike me, and the mothers with the children.
32:11.kjv: Deliver me, I pray thee, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau: for I fear him, lest he will come and smite me, and the mother with the children.

bsb: I will surely make you prosper,
32:12.web: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”
32:12.kjv: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.

bsb: and from what he had brought
32:13.web: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him, a present for Esau, his brother:
32:13.kjv: And he lodged there that same night; and took of that which came to his hand a present for Esau his brother;

32:14.web: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
32:14.kjv: Two hundred she goats, and twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,

32:15.web: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
32:15.kjv: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.

32:16.web: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”
32:16.kjv: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, every drove by themselves; and said unto his servants, Pass over before me, and put a space betwixt drove and drove.

32:17.web: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’
32:17.kjv: And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

32:18.web: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”
32:18.kjv: Then thou shalt say, They be thy servant Jacob’s; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau: and, behold, also he is behind us.

32:19.web: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.
32:19.kjv: And so commanded he the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying, On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau, when ye find him.

32:20.web: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”
32:20.kjv: And say ye moreover, Behold, thy servant Jacob is behind us. For he said, I will appease him with the present that goeth before me, and afterward I will see his face; peradventure he will accept of me.

32:21.web: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
32:21.kjv: So went the present over before him: and himself lodged that night in the company.

32:22.web: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.
32:22.kjv: And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

32:23.web: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.
32:23.kjv: And he took them, and sent them over the brook, and sent over that he had.

32:24.web: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.
32:24.kjv: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.

32:25.web: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained, as he wrestled.
32:25.kjv: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.

32:26.web: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go, unless you bless me.”
32:26.kjv: And he said, Let me go, for the day breaketh. And he said, I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.

32:27.web: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.
32:27.kjv: And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob.

32:28.web: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”
32:28.kjv: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.

32:29.web: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” He blessed him there.
32:29.kjv: And Jacob asked him, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, thy name. And he said, Wherefore is it that thou dost ask after my name? And he blessed him there.

32:30.web: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for, he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”
32:30.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

32:31.web: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.
32:31.kjv: And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

32:32.web: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.
32:32.kjv: Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew that shrank.

33:1.web: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.
33:1.kjv: And Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau came, and with him four hundred men. And he divided the children unto Leah, and unto Rachel, and unto the two handmaids.

33:2.web: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
33:2.kjv: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.

33:3.web: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
33:3.kjv: And he passed over before them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

33:4.web: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
33:4.kjv: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.

33:5.web: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”
33:5.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, Who are those with thee? And he said, The children which God hath graciously given thy servant.

33:6.web: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.
33:6.kjv: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.

33:7.web: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.
33:7.kjv: And Leah also with her children came near, and bowed themselves: and after came Joseph near and Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

33:8.web: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”
33:8.kjv: And he said, What meanest thou by all this drove which I met? And he said, These are to find grace in the sight of my lord.

33:9.web: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”
33:9.kjv: And Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep that thou hast unto thyself.

bsb: since you have received me favorably.
33:10.web: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.
33:10.kjv: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.

33:11.web: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.
33:11.kjv: Take, I pray thee, my blessing that is brought to thee; because God hath dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough. And he urged him, and he took it.

bsb: Let us be on our way,
33:12.web: Esau said, “Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before you.”
33:12.kjv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.

33:13.web: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.
33:13.kjv: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

33:14.web: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”
33:14.kjv: Let my lord, I pray thee, pass over before his servant: and I will lead on softly, according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure, until I come unto my lord unto Seir.

33:15.web: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the folk who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
33:15.kjv: And Esau said, Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me. And he said, What needeth it? let me find grace in the sight of my lord.

33:16.web: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
33:16.kjv: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.

33:17.web: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
33:17.kjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built him an house, and made booths for his cattle: therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

33:18.web: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.
33:18.kjv: And Jacob came to Shalem, a city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan-aram; and pitched his tent before the city.

33:19.web: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
33:19.kjv: And he bought a parcel of a field, where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for an hundred pieces of money.

33:20.web: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.
33:20.kjv: And he erected there an altar, and called it El-elohe-Israel.

34:1.web: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
34:1.kjv: And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

34:2.web: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.
34:2.kjv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.

34:3.web: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.
34:3.kjv: And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.

34:4.web: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
34:4.kjv: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.

34:5.web: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.
34:5.kjv: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter: now his sons were with his cattle in the field: and Jacob held his peace until they were come.

34:6.web: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.
34:6.kjv: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him.

34:7.web: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; a thing ought not to be done.
34:7.kjv: And the sons of Jacob came out of the field when they heard it: and the men were grieved, and they were very wroth, because he had wrought folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter; which thing ought not to be done.

34:8.web: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
34:8.kjv: And Hamor communed with them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter: I pray you give her him to wife.

34:9.web: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
34:9.kjv: And make ye marriages with us, and give your daughters unto us, and take our daughters unto you.

34:10.web: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”
34:10.kjv: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.

34:11.web: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.
34:11.kjv: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren, Let me find grace in your eyes, and what ye shall say unto me I will give.

34:12.web: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”
34:12.kjv: Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

34:13.web: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit, and spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,
34:13.kjv: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

34:14.web: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.
34:14.kjv: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:

34:15.web: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised;
34:15.kjv: But in this will we consent unto you: If ye will be as we be, that every male of you be circumcised;

34:16.web: then will we give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
34:16.kjv: Then will we give our daughters unto you, and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

34:17.web: But if you will not listen to us, to be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”
34:17.kjv: But if ye will not hearken unto us, to be circumcised; then will we take our daughter, and we will be gone.

34:18.web: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
34:18.kjv: And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

34:19.web: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.
34:19.kjv: And the young man deferred not to do the thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter: and he was more honourable than all the house of his father.

34:20.web: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,
34:20.kjv: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city, and communed with the men of their city, saying,

34:21.web: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.
34:21.kjv: These men are peaceable with us; therefore let them dwell in the land, and trade therein; for the land, behold, it is large enough for them; let us take their daughters to us for wives, and let us give them our daughters.

34:22.web: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.
34:22.kjv: Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us, to be one people, if every male among us be circumcised, as they are circumcised.

34:23.web: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let us give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
34:23.kjv: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours? only let us consent unto them, and they will dwell with us.

34:24.web: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
34:24.kjv: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city; and every male was circumcised, all that went out of the gate of his city.

34:25.web: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.
34:25.kjv: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

34:26.web: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
34:26.kjv: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.

34:27.web: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
34:27.kjv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister.

34:28.web: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,
34:28.kjv: They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field,

34:29.web: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.
34:29.kjv: And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive, and spoiled even all that was in the house.

34:30.web: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”
34:30.kjv: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.

34:31.web: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
34:31.kjv: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

35:1.web: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”
35:1.kjv: And God said unto Jacob, Arise, go up to Bethel, and dwell there: and make there an altar unto God, that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother.

35:2.web: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, change your garments.
35:2.kjv: Then Jacob said unto his household, and to all that were with him, Put away the strange gods that are among you, and be clean, and change your garments:

35:3.web: Let us arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”
35:3.kjv: And let us arise, and go up to Bethel; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.

35:4.web: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.
35:4.kjv: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand, and all their earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

35:5.web: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
35:5.kjv: And they journeyed: and the terror of God was upon the cities that were round about them, and they did not pursue after the sons of Jacob.

35:6.web: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
35:6.kjv: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.

35:7.web: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.
35:7.kjv: And he built there an altar, and called the place El-beth-el: because there God appeared unto him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

35:8.web: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.
35:8.kjv: But Deborah Rebekah’s nurse died, and she was buried beneath Bethel under an oak: and the name of it was called Allon-bachuth.

35:9.web: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.
35:9.kjv: And God appeared unto Jacob again, when he came out of Padan-aram, and blessed him.

35:10.web: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.
35:10.kjv: And God said unto him, Thy name is Jacob: thy name shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be thy name: and he called his name Israel.

35:11.web: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.
35:11.kjv: And God said unto him, I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall be of thee, and kings shall come out of thy loins;

35:12.web: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you will I give the land.”
35:12.kjv: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.

35:13.web: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.
35:13.kjv: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.

35:14.web: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.
35:14.kjv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he talked with him, even a pillar of stone: and he poured a drink offering thereon, and he poured oil thereon.

35:15.web: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.
35:15.kjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.

bsb: began to give birth, and her labor
35:16.web: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.
35:16.kjv: And they journeyed from Bethel; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath: and Rachel travailed, and she had hard labour.

35:17.web: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”
35:17.kjv: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.

35:18.web: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.
35:18.kjv: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

35:19.web: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).
35:19.kjv: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.

35:20.web: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
35:20.kjv: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave: that is the pillar of Rachel’s grave unto this day.

35:21.web: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
35:21.kjv: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.

35:22.web: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
35:22.kjv: And it came to pass, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Israel heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

35:23.web: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
35:23.kjv: The sons of Leah; Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Zebulun:

35:24.web: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
35:24.kjv: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

35:25.web: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.
35:25.kjv: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:

35:26.web: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
35:26.kjv: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid; Gad, and Asher: these are the sons of Jacob, which were born to him in Padan-aram.

35:27.web: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.
35:27.kjv: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre, unto the city of Arbah, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac sojourned.

35:28.web: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
35:28.kjv: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.

35:29.web: Isaac gave up the spirit, and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.
35:29.kjv: And Isaac gave up the ghost, and died, and was gathered unto his people, being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

36:1.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
36:1.kjv: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.

36:2.web: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
36:2.kjv: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;

36:3.web: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
36:3.kjv: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.

36:4.web: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
36:4.kjv: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;

36:5.web: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
36:5.kjv: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.

36:6.web: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
36:6.kjv: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.

36:7.web: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
36:7.kjv: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.

36:8.web: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
36:8.kjv: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

36:9.web: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
36:9.kjv: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:

36:10.web: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
36:10.kjv: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.

36:11.web: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
36:11.kjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

36:12.web: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
36:12.kjv: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.

36:13.web: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
36:13.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

36:14.web: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
36:14.kjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.

36:15.web: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
36:15.kjv: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,

36:16.web: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
36:16.kjv: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.

36:17.web: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
36:17.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.

36:18.web: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
36:18.kjv: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

36:19.web: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
36:19.kjv: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.

36:20.web: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
36:20.kjv: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,

36:21.web: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
36:21.kjv: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

36:22.web: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
36:22.kjv: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.

36:23.web: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
36:23.kjv: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

36:24.web: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
36:24.kjv: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.

36:25.web: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
36:25.kjv: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.

36:26.web: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
36:26.kjv: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.

36:27.web: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
36:27.kjv: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.

36:28.web: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
36:28.kjv: The children of Dishan are these: Uz, and Aran.

36:29.web: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
36:29.kjv: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,

36:30.web: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan: these are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
36:30.kjv: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.

36:31.web: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
36:31.kjv: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.

36:32.web: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
36:32.kjv: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

36:33.web: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
36:33.kjv: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.

36:34.web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
36:34.kjv: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.

36:35.web: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
36:35.kjv: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.

36:36.web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
36:36.kjv: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.

36:37.web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
36:37.kjv: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.

36:38.web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan, the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
36:38.kjv: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.

36:39.web: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
36:39.kjv: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

36:40.web: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
36:40.kjv: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,

36:41.web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
36:41.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

36:42.web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
36:42.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

36:43.web: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
36:43.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.

37:1.web: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.
37:1.kjv: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.

37:2.web: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.
37:2.kjv: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

37:3.web: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a coat of many colors.
37:3.kjv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of many colours.

37:4.web: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.
37:4.kjv: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

37:5.web: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.
37:5.kjv: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.

37:6.web: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
37:6.kjv: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

37:7.web: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”
37:7.kjv: For, behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.

37:8.web: His brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Or will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.
37:8.kjv: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

37:9.web: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”
37:9.kjv: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

37:10.web: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to you to the earth?”
37:10.kjv: And he told it to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What is this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?

37:11.web: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
37:11.kjv: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

37:12.web: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
37:12.kjv: And his brethren went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

37:13.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”
37:13.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here am I.

37:14.web: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
37:14.kjv: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

37:15.web: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”
37:15.kjv: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?

37:16.web: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”
37:16.kjv: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed their flocks.

37:17.web: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.
37:17.kjv: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.

37:18.web: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.
37:18.kjv: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.

37:19.web: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.
37:19.kjv: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.

37:20.web: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”
37:20.kjv: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.

37:21.web: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”
37:21.kjv: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

37:22.web: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.
37:22.kjv: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

37:23.web: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his coat, the coat of many colors that was on him;
37:23.kjv: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

bsb: into the pit. Now the pit
37:24.web: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.
37:24.kjv: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

37:25.web: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.
37:25.kjv: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

37:26.web: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
37:26.kjv: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

37:27.web: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.
37:27.kjv: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

37:28.web: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. They brought Joseph into Egypt.
37:28.kjv: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

37:29.web: Reuben returned to the pit; and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
37:29.kjv: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.

bsb: What am I going to do?”
37:30.web: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”
37:30.kjv: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

37:31.web: They took Joseph’s coat, and killed a male goat, and dipped the coat in the blood.
37:31.kjv: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

37:32.web: They took the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, whether it is your son’s coat or not.”
37:32.kjv: And they sent the coat of many colours, and they brought it to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it be thy son’s coat or no.

bsb: has surely been torn to pieces!”
37:33.web: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s coat. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”
37:33.kjv: And he knew it, and said, It is my son’s coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.

37:34.web: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
37:34.kjv: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

37:35.web: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son mourning.” His father wept for him.
37:35.kjv: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.

37:36.web: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
37:36.kjv: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, and captain of the guard.

38:1.web: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
38:1.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

bsb: and he took her as a wife
38:2.web: Judah saw there a certain Canaanite man named Shua’s daughter. He took her, and went in to her.
38:2.kjv: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite, whose name was Shuah; and he took her, and went in unto her.

38:3.web: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
38:3.kjv: And she conceived, and bare a son; and he called his name Er.

38:4.web: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.
38:4.kjv: And she conceived again, and bare a son; and she called his name Onan.

bsb: that she gave birth to him.
38:5.web: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bore him.
38:5.kjv: And she yet again conceived, and bare a son; and called his name Shelah: and he was at Chezib, when she bare him.

38:6.web: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
38:6.kjv: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, whose name was Tamar.

bsb: of the LORD; so the LORD
38:7.web: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in Yahweh’s sight. Yahweh killed him.
38:7.kjv: And Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; and the LORD slew him.

bsb: Perform your duty as her brother-
38:8.web: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”
38:8.kjv: And Judah said unto Onan, Go in unto thy brother’s wife, and marry her, and raise up seed to thy brother.

38:9.web: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled it on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.
38:9.kjv: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

bsb: so He put Onan to death
38:10.web: The thing which he did was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and he killed him also.
38:10.kjv: And the thing which he did displeased the LORD: wherefore he slew him also.

38:11.web: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up”; for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
38:11.kjv: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law, Remain a widow at thy father’s house, till Shelah my son be grown: for he said, Lest peradventure he die also, as his brethren did. And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.

38:12.web: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.
38:12.kjv: And in process of time the daughter of Shuah Judah’s wife died; and Judah was comforted, and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnath, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.

38:13.web: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
38:13.kjv: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.

38:14.web: She took off her the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is by the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.
38:14.kjv: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

38:15.web: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
38:15.kjv: When Judah saw her, he thought her to be an harlot; because she had covered her face.

38:16.web: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”
38:16.kjv: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?

38:17.web: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”
38:17.kjv: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?

38:18.web: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.
38:18.kjv: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

38:19.web: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.
38:19.kjv: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

bsb: the items he had left with
38:20.web: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.
38:20.kjv: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand: but he found her not.

38:21.web: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”
38:21.kjv: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, Where is the harlot, that was openly by the way side? And they said, There was no harlot in this place.

38:22.web: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
38:22.kjv: And he returned to Judah, and said, I cannot find her; and also the men of the place said, that there was no harlot in this place.

38:23.web: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”
38:23.kjv: And Judah said, Let her take it to her, lest we be shamed: behold, I sent this kid, and thou hast not found her.

bsb: Let her be burned to death!”
38:24.web: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”
38:24.kjv: And it came to pass about three months after, that it was told Judah, saying, Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot; and also, behold, she is with child by whoredom. And Judah said, Bring her forth, and let her be burnt.

38:25.web: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “By the man, whose these are, I am with child.” She also said, “Please discern whose are these—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”
38:25.kjv: When she was brought forth, she sent to her father in law, saying, By the man, whose these are, am I with child: and she said, Discern, I pray thee, whose are these, the signet, and bracelets, and staff.

38:26.web: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.
38:26.kjv: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

38:27.web: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.
38:27.kjv: And it came to pass in the time of her travail, that, behold, twins were in her womb.

38:28.web: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”
38:28.kjv: And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first,

bsb: But when he pulled his hand
38:29.web: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.
38:29.kjv: And it came to pass, as he drew back his hand, that, behold, his brother came out: and she said, How hast thou broken forth? this breach be upon thee: therefore his name was called Pharez.

38:30.web: Afterward his brother came out, that had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
38:30.kjv: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.

39:1.web: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.
39:1.kjv: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

39:2.web: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
39:2.kjv: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

39:3.web: His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.
39:3.kjv: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

39:4.web: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.
39:4.kjv: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

bsb: that he put Joseph in charge
39:5.web: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, Yahweh blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. Yahweh’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.
39:5.kjv: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

39:6.web: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.
39:6.kjv: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.

39:7.web: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
39:7.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

39:8.web: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.
39:8.kjv: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

39:9.web: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”
39:9.kjv: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

39:10.web: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
39:10.kjv: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

39:11.web: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.
39:11.kjv: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

39:12.web: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.
39:12.kjv: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

39:13.web: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,
39:13.kjv: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

39:14.web: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.
39:14.kjv: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

39:15.web: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
39:15.kjv: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

39:16.web: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.
39:16.kjv: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

39:17.web: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,
39:17.kjv: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

bsb: but when I screamed for help,
39:18.web: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”
39:18.kjv: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

39:19.web: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.
39:19.kjv: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

39:20.web: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.
39:20.kjv: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

39:21.web: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
39:21.kjv: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

39:22.web: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.
39:22.kjv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

39:23.web: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because Yahweh was with him; and that which he did, Yahweh made it prosper.
39:23.kjv: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.

40:1.web: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
40:1.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

40:2.web: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.
40:2.kjv: And Pharaoh was wroth against two of his officers, against the chief of the butlers, and against the chief of the bakers.

40:3.web: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
40:3.kjv: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

bsb: and he became their personal attendant.
40:4.web: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.
40:4.kjv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them: and they continued a season in ward.

40:5.web: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.
40:5.kjv: And they dreamed a dream both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, which were bound in the prison.

40:6.web: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.
