40:6.kjv: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

40:7.web: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”
40:7.kjv: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

40:8.web: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”
40:8.kjv: And they said unto him, We have dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter of it. And Joseph said unto them, Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.

40:9.web: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,
40:9.kjv: And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine was before me;

40:10.web: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.
40:10.kjv: And in the vine were three branches: and it was as though it budded, and her blossoms shot forth; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes:

40:11.web: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”
40:11.kjv: And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.

40:12.web: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.
40:12.kjv: And Joseph said unto him, This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days:

40:13.web: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.
40:13.kjv: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thine head, and restore thee unto thy place: and thou shalt deliver Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, after the former manner when thou wast his butler.

bsb: that he might bring me out
40:14.web: But remember me when it will be well with you, and please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.
40:14.kjv: But think on me when it shall be well with thee, and shew kindness, I pray thee, unto me, and make mention of me unto Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house:

40:15.web: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”
40:15.kjv: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews: and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

40:16.web: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.
40:16.kjv: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said unto Joseph, I also was in my dream, and, behold, I had three white baskets on my head:

40:17.web: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”
40:17.kjv: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head.

40:18.web: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.
40:18.kjv: And Joseph answered and said, This is the interpretation thereof: The three baskets are three days:

40:19.web: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”
40:19.kjv: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee, and shall hang thee on a tree; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee.

40:20.web: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.
40:20.kjv: And it came to pass the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, that he made a feast unto all his servants: and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.

bsb: so that he once again placed
40:21.web: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;
40:21.kjv: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand:

40:22.web: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
40:22.kjv: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.

40:23.web: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.
40:23.kjv: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph, but forgat him.

41:1.web: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed: and behold, he stood by the river.
41:1.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh dreamed: and, behold, he stood by the river.

41:2.web: Behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.
41:2.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.

41:3.web: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.
41:3.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them out of the river, ill favoured and leanfleshed; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river.

41:4.web: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.
41:4.kjv: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine. So Pharaoh awoke.

41:5.web: He slept and dreamed a second time: and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.
41:5.kjv: And he slept and dreamed the second time: and, behold, seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good.

41:6.web: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
41:6.kjv: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.

41:7.web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
41:7.kjv: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.

41:8.web: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
41:8.kjv: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and all the wise men thereof: and Pharaoh told them his dream; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh.

41:9.web: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.
41:9.kjv: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh, saying, I do remember my faults this day:

41:10.web: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.
41:10.kjv: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants, and put me in ward in the captain of the guard’s house, both me and the chief baker:

41:11.web: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. We dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
41:11.kjv: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

41:12.web: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. To each man according to his dream he interpreted.
41:12.kjv: And there was there with us a young man, an Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard; and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams; to each man according to his dream he did interpret.

bsb: and the other man was hanged.”
41:13.web: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”
41:13.kjv: And it came to pass, as he interpreted to us, so it was; me he restored unto mine office, and him he hanged.

41:14.web: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.
41:14.kjv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon: and he shaved himself, and changed his raiment, and came in unto Pharaoh.

41:15.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”
41:15.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I have dreamed a dream, and there is none that can interpret it: and I have heard say of thee, that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it.

41:16.web: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
41:16.kjv: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, It is not in me: God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace.

41:17.web: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river:
41:17.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, In my dream, behold, I stood upon the bank of the river:

41:18.web: and behold, there came up out of the river seven cattle, fat and sleek. They fed in the marsh grass,
41:18.kjv: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

41:19.web: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.
41:19.kjv: And, behold, seven other kine came up after them, poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness:

41:20.web: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle,
41:20.kjv: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:

41:21.web: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
41:21.kjv: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they were still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

41:22.web: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good:
41:22.kjv: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:

41:23.web: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.
41:23.kjv: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

41:24.web: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”
41:24.kjv: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

41:25.web: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.
41:25.kjv: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh is one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do.

41:26.web: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.
41:26.kjv: The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

41:27.web: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.
41:27.kjv: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them are seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.

41:28.web: That is the thing which I spoke to Pharaoh. What God is about to do he has shown to Pharaoh.
41:28.kjv: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.

41:29.web: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt.
41:29.kjv: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

41:30.web: There will arise after them seven years of famine, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
41:30.kjv: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;

41:31.web: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.
41:31.kjv: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it shall be very grievous.

41:32.web: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
41:32.kjv: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; it is because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

41:33.web: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
41:33.kjv: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.

41:34.web: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.
41:34.kjv: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.

41:35.web: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and lay up grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
41:35.kjv: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.

41:36.web: The food will be for a store to the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; that the land not perish through the famine.”
41:36.kjv: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.

41:37.web: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
41:37.kjv: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

41:38.web: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”
41:38.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find such a one as this is, a man in whom the Spirit of God is?

41:39.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.
41:39.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, there is none so discreet and wise as thou art:

41:40.web: You shall be over my house, and according to your word will all my people be ruled. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”
41:40.kjv: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.

41:41.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”
41:41.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.

41:42.web: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck,
41:42.kjv: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;

41:43.web: and he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.
41:43.kjv: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.

41:44.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you shall no man lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”
41:44.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.

41:45.web: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
41:45.kjv: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.

41:46.web: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
41:46.kjv: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

41:47.web: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.
41:47.kjv: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.

bsb: in the cities. In every city
41:48.web: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was around every city, he laid up in the same.
41:48.kjv: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which was round about every city, laid he up in the same.

41:49.web: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.
41:49.kjv: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.

41:50.web: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.
41:50.kjv: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

41:51.web: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”
41:51.kjv: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

41:52.web: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
41:52.kjv: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.

41:53.web: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.
41:53.kjv: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.

41:54.web: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
41:54.kjv: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

41:55.web: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”
41:55.kjv: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.

41:56.web: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
41:56.kjv: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: and Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.

41:57.web: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
41:57.kjv: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy corn; because that the famine was so sore in all lands.

bsb: are you staring at one another?”
42:1.web: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”
42:1.kjv: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

42:2.web: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”
42:2.kjv: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

42:3.web: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
42:3.kjv: And Joseph’s ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

42:4.web: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”
42:4.kjv: But Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

42:5.web: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
42:5.kjv: And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

42:6.web: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.
42:6.kjv: And Joseph was the governor over the land, and he it was that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph’s brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth.

bsb: he recognized them, but he treated them as strangers
42:7.web: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan to buy food.”
42:7.kjv: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

42:8.web: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.
42:8.kjv: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

42:9.web: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”
42:9.kjv: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye are spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

42:10.web: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.
42:10.kjv: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

42:11.web: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”
42:11.kjv: We are all one man’s sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.

42:12.web: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”
42:12.kjv: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

42:13.web: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”
42:13.kjv: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is not.

42:14.web: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’
42:14.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, That is it that I spake unto you, saying, Ye are spies:

42:15.web: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.
42:15.kjv: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

42:16.web: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”
42:16.kjv: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.

42:17.web: He put them all together into custody for three days.
42:17.kjv: And he put them all together into ward three days.

42:18.web: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.
42:18.kjv: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; for I fear God:

42:19.web: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.
42:19.kjv: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

42:20.web: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.
42:20.kjv: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

42:21.web: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”
42:21.kjv: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

42:22.web: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”
42:22.kjv: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

42:23.web: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.
42:23.kjv: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.

42:24.web: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.
42:24.kjv: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

42:25.web: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.
42:25.kjv: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

42:26.web: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.
42:26.kjv: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

bsb: At the place where they lodged for the night,
42:27.web: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.
42:27.kjv: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.

42:28.web: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”
42:28.kjv: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?

42:29.web: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,
42:29.kjv: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

42:30.web: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
42:30.kjv: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.

42:31.web: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.
42:31.kjv: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:

42:32.web: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’
42:32.kjv: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

42:33.web: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.
42:33.kjv: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:

42:34.web: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”
42:34.kjv: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

42:35.web: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.
42:35.kjv: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

bsb: You have deprived me of my sons.
42:36.web: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”
42:36.kjv: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved of my children: Joseph is not, and Simeon is not, and ye will take Benjamin away: all these things are against me.

42:37.web: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”
42:37.kjv: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

bsb: you will bring my gray hair
42:38.web: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”
42:38.kjv: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

43:1.web: The famine was severe in the land.
43:1.kjv: And the famine was sore in the land.

43:2.web: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”
43:2.kjv: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said unto them, Go again, buy us a little food.

43:3.web: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’
43:3.kjv: And Judah spake unto him, saying, The man did solemnly protest unto us, saying, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

43:4.web: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food,
43:4.kjv: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:

43:5.web: but if you’ll not send him, we’ll not go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”
43:5.kjv: But if thou wilt not send him, we will not go down: for the man said unto us, Ye shall not see my face, except your brother be with you.

43:6.web: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”
43:6.kjv: And Israel said, Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me, as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother?

43:7.web: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down?’”
43:7.kjv: And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

bsb: and we will go at once,
43:8.web: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.
43:8.kjv: And Judah said unto Israel his father, Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go; that we may live, and not die, both we, and thou, and also our little ones.

43:9.web: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever,
43:9.kjv: I will be surety for him; of my hand shalt thou require him: if I bring him not unto thee, and set him before thee, then let me bear the blame for ever:

bsb: we could have come and gone
43:10.web: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”
43:10.kjv: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.

43:11.web: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this. Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;
43:11.kjv: And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

43:12.web: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
43:12.kjv: And take double money in your hand; and the money that was brought again in the mouth of your sacks, carry it again in your hand; peradventure it was an oversight:

43:13.web: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.
43:13.kjv: Take also your brother, and arise, go again unto the man:

bsb: I am bereaved, I am bereaved.”
43:14.web: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”
43:14.kjv: And God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may send away your other brother, and Benjamin. If I be bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.

43:15.web: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
43:15.kjv: And the men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and rose up, and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

43:16.web: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”
43:16.kjv: And when Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the ruler of his house, Bring these men home, and slay, and make ready; for these men shall dine with me at noon.

43:17.web: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.
43:17.kjv: And the man did as Joseph bade; and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.

43:18.web: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”
43:18.kjv: And the men were afraid, because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, Because of the money that was returned in our sacks at the first time are we brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, and fall upon us, and take us for bondmen, and our asses.

43:19.web: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,
43:19.kjv: And they came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they communed with him at the door of the house,

43:20.web: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.
43:20.kjv: And said, O sir, we came indeed down at the first time to buy food:

bsb: the place we lodged for the night,
and we have brought it back
43:21.web: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.
43:21.kjv: And it came to pass, when we came to the inn, that we opened our sacks, and, behold, every man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight: and we have brought it again in our hand.

43:22.web: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”
43:22.kjv: And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

43:23.web: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.
43:23.kjv: And he said, Peace be to you, fear not: your God, and the God of your father, hath given you treasure in your sacks: I had your money. And he brought Simeon out unto them.

43:24.web: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.
43:24.kjv: And the man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their asses provender.

43:25.web: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.
43:25.kjv: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon: for they heard that they should eat bread there.

43:26.web: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.
43:26.kjv: And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves to him to the earth.

43:27.web: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”
43:27.kjv: And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

43:28.web: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.
43:28.kjv: And they answered, Thy servant our father is in good health, he is yet alive. And they bowed down their heads, and made obeisance.

bsb: you told me about?” Then he declared, “
43:29.web: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”
43:29.kjv: And he lifted up his eyes, and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother’s son, and said, Is this your younger brother, of whom ye spake unto me? And he said, God be gracious unto thee, my son.

43:30.web: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.
43:30.kjv: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

43:31.web: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”
43:31.kjv: And he washed his face, and went out, and refrained himself, and said, Set on bread.

43:32.web: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians, that ate with him, by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat bread with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.
43:32.kjv: And they set on for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians, which did eat with him, by themselves: because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

43:33.web: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled one with another.
43:33.kjv: And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth: and the men marvelled one at another.

43:34.web: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.
43:34.kjv: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.

44:1.web: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.
44:1.kjv: And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put every man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

44:2.web: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.
44:2.kjv: And put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, and his corn money. And he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

44:3.web: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.
44:3.kjv: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their asses.

44:4.web: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?
44:4.kjv: And when they were gone out of the city, and not yet far off, Joseph said unto his steward, Up, follow after the men; and when thou dost overtake them, say unto them, Wherefore have ye rewarded evil for good?

44:5.web: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”
44:5.kjv: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh, and whereby indeed he divineth? ye have done evil in so doing.

44:6.web: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.
44:6.kjv: And he overtook them, and he spake unto them these same words.

44:7.web: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!
44:7.kjv: And they said unto him, Wherefore saith my lord these words? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing:

44:8.web: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?
44:8.kjv: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan: how then should we steal out of thy lord’s house silver or gold?

44:9.web: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”
44:9.kjv: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found, both let him die, and we also will be my lord’s bondmen.

44:10.web: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words: he with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”
44:10.kjv: And he said, Now also let it be according unto your words; he with whom it is found shall be my servant; and ye shall be blameless.

44:11.web: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.
44:11.kjv: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.

44:12.web: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.
44:12.kjv: And he searched, and began at the eldest, and left at the youngest: and the cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

44:13.web: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.
44:13.kjv: Then they rent their clothes, and laded every man his ass, and returned to the city.

44:14.web: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.
44:14.kjv: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph’s house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.

44:15.web: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed divine?”
44:15.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, What deed is this that ye have done? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine?

44:16.web: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? Or how will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we, and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”
44:16.kjv: And Judah said, What shall we say unto my lord? what shall we speak? or how shall we clear ourselves? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants: behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we, and he also with whom the cup is found.

44:17.web: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”
44:17.kjv: And he said, God forbid that I should do so: but the man in whose hand the cup is found, he shall be my servant; and as for you, get you up in peace unto your father.

44:18.web: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.
44:18.kjv: Then Judah came near unto him, and said, Oh my lord, let thy servant, I pray thee, speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not thine anger burn against thy servant: for thou art even as Pharaoh.

44:19.web: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’
44:19.kjv: My lord asked his servants, saying, Have ye a father, or a brother?

44:20.web: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’
44:20.kjv: And we said unto my lord, We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loveth him.

44:21.web: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
44:21.kjv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Bring him down unto me, that I may set mine eyes upon him.

44:22.web: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’
44:22.kjv: And we said unto my lord, The lad cannot leave his father: for if he should leave his father, his father would die.

44:23.web: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’
44:23.kjv: And thou saidst unto thy servants, Except your youngest brother come down with you, ye shall see my face no more.

44:24.web: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
44:24.kjv: And it came to pass when we came up unto thy servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

44:25.web: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’
44:25.kjv: And our father said, Go again, and buy us a little food.

44:26.web: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’
44:26.kjv: And we said, We cannot go down: if our youngest brother be with us, then will we go down: for we may not see the man’s face, except our youngest brother be with us.

44:27.web: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons:
44:27.kjv: And thy servant my father said unto us, Ye know that my wife bare me two sons:

bsb: he has been torn to pieces.”
44:28.web: and the one went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces”; and I haven’t seen him since.
44:28.kjv: And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

bsb: you will bring my gray hair
44:29.web: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’
44:29.kjv: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.

44:30.web: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;
44:30.kjv: Now therefore when I come to thy servant my father, and the lad be not with us; seeing that his life is bound up in the lad’s life;

bsb: will have brought the gray hair
44:31.web: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.
44:31.kjv: It shall come to pass, when he seeth that the lad is not with us, that he will die: and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave.

44:32.web: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’
44:32.kjv: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father, saying, If I bring him not unto thee, then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever.

44:33.web: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.
44:33.kjv: Now therefore, I pray thee, let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord; and let the lad go up with his brethren.

44:34.web: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”
44:34.kjv: For how shall I go up to my father, and the lad be not with me? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father.

45:1.web: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he cried, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
45:1.kjv: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

45:2.web: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.
45:2.kjv: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

45:3.web: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.
45:3.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I am Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence.

bsb: come near me.” And they did so. “
45:4.web: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. “He said, I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
45:4.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

45:5.web: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
45:5.kjv: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life.

45:6.web: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.
45:6.kjv: For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

45:7.web: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.
45:7.kjv: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

45:8.web: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
45:8.kjv: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

45:9.web: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.
45:9.kjv: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

45:10.web: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.
45:10.kjv: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children’s children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

45:11.web: There I will nourish you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’
45:11.kjv: And there will I nourish thee; for yet there are five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

45:12.web: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
45:12.kjv: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you.

45:13.web: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”
45:13.kjv: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

bsb: Then Joseph threw his arms around
45:14.web: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
45:14.kjv: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

45:15.web: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.
45:15.kjv: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

45:16.web: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.
45:16.kjv: And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, Joseph’s brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

45:17.web: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this. Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.
45:17.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

45:18.web: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’
45:18.kjv: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

bsb: are also directed to tell them: ‘
45:19.web: Now you are commanded: do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
45:19.kjv: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

45:20.web: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”
45:20.kjv: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

45:21.web: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.
45:21.kjv: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

45:22.web: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.
45:22.kjv: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, and five changes of raiment.

45:23.web: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
45:23.kjv: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.

45:24.web: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
45:24.kjv: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

45:25.web: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.
45:25.kjv: And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

45:26.web: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.
45:26.kjv: And told him, saying, Joseph is yet alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob’s heart fainted, for he believed them not.

45:27.web: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.
45:27.kjv: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

45:28.web: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
45:28.kjv: And Israel said, It is enough; Joseph my son is yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.

46:1.web: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
46:1.kjv: And Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beer-sheba, and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac.

46:2.web: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”
46:2.kjv: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night, and said, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.

46:3.web: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.
46:3.kjv: And he said, I am God, the God of thy father: fear not to go down into Egypt; for I will there make of thee a great nation:

46:4.web: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph will close your eyes.”
46:4.kjv: I will go down with thee into Egypt; and I will also surely bring thee up again: and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes.

46:5.web: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
46:5.kjv: And Jacob rose up from Beer-sheba: and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, and their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

46:6.web: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,
46:6.kjv: And they took their cattle, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob, and all his seed with him:

46:7.web: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.
46:7.kjv: His sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and all his seed brought he with him into Egypt.

46:8.web: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
46:8.kjv: And these are the names of the children of Israel, which came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

46:9.web: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
46:9.kjv: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.

46:10.web: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
46:10.kjv: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.

46:11.web: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
46:11.kjv: And the sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

46:12.web: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
46:12.kjv: And the sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah, and Pharez, and Zarah: but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

46:13.web: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.
46:13.kjv: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.

46:14.web: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
46:14.kjv: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.

46:15.web: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.
46:15.kjv: These be the sons of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob in Padan-aram, with his daughter Dinah: all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three.

46:16.web: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
46:16.kjv: And the sons of Gad; Ziphion, and Haggi, Shuni, and Ezbon, Eri, and Arodi, and Areli.

46:17.web: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
46:17.kjv: And the sons of Asher; Jimnah, and Ishuah, and Isui, and Beriah, and Serah their sister: and the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel.

46:18.web: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.
46:18.kjv: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter, and these she bare unto Jacob, even sixteen souls.

46:19.web: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
46:19.kjv: The sons of Rachel Jacob’s wife; Joseph, and Benjamin.

46:20.web: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
46:20.kjv: And unto Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, which Asenath the daughter of Poti-pherah priest of On bare unto him.

46:21.web: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
46:21.kjv: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah, and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, Ehi, and Rosh, Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard.

46:22.web: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.
46:22.kjv: These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

46:23.kjv: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

46:24.web: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
46:24.kjv: And the sons of Naphtali; Jahzeel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shillem.

46:25.web: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.
46:25.kjv: These are the sons of Bilhah, which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter, and she bare these unto Jacob: all the souls were seven.

46:26.web: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
46:26.kjv: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt, which came out of his loins, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were threescore and six;

46:27.web: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.
46:27.kjv: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.

46:28.web: He sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
46:28.kjv: And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph, to direct his face unto Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.

46:29.web: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.
46:29.kjv: And Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet Israel his father, to Goshen, and presented himself unto him; and he fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

46:30.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
46:30.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.

46:31.web: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
46:31.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, and unto his father’s house, I will go up, and shew Pharaoh, and say unto him, My brethren, and my father’s house, which were in the land of Canaan, are come unto me;

46:32.web: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’
46:32.kjv: And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

46:33.web: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’
46:33.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

bsb: you will be allowed to settle
46:34.web: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”
46:34.kjv: That ye shall say, Thy servants’ trade hath been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that ye may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

47:1.web: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”
47:1.kjv: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

47:2.web: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.
47:2.kjv: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

47:3.web: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”
47:3.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Thy servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

47:4.web: They said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”
47:4.kjv: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

47:5.web: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.
47:5.kjv: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee:

47:6.web: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”
47:6.kjv: The land of Egypt is before thee; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if thou knowest any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

47:7.web: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
47:7.kjv: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

47:8.web: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How many are the days of the years of your life?”
47:8.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

47:9.web: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The days of the years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”
47:9.kjv: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

47:10.web: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.
47:10.kjv: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

bsb: part of the land, the district
47:11.web: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
47:11.kjv: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

47:12.web: Joseph nourished his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.
47:12.kjv: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

47:13.web: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
47:13.kjv: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

47:14.web: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
47:14.kjv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

47:15.web: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”
47:15.kjv: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in thy presence? for the money faileth.

47:16.web: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”
47:16.kjv: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

47:17.web: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.
47:17.kjv: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

47:18.web: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.
47:18.kjv: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also hath our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

47:19.web: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”
47:19.kjv: Wherefore shall we die before thine eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

47:20.web: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.
47:20.kjv: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

47:21.web: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.
47:21.kjv: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

bsb: it had been given to them by Pharaoh.
47:22.web: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.
47:22.kjv: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

47:23.web: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
47:23.kjv: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.

47:24.web: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”
47:24.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that ye shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

47:25.web: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”
47:25.kjv: And they said, Thou hast saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

bsb: of the produce belongs to Pharaoh,
47:26.web: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.
47:26.kjv: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.

47:27.web: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.
47:27.kjv: And Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

bsb: years, and the length of his life
47:28.web: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.
47:28.kjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

47:29.web: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,
47:29.kjv: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in thy sight, put, I pray thee, thy hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray thee, in Egypt:

47:30.web: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” He said, “I will do as you have said.”
47:30.kjv: But I will lie with my fathers, and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as thou hast said.

47:31.web: He said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.
47:31.kjv: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Israel bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

48:1.web: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
48:1.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, thy father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

48:2.web: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.
48:2.kjv: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, thy son Joseph cometh unto thee: and Israel strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

48:3.web: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
48:3.kjv: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

48:4.web: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’
48:4.kjv: And said unto me, Behold, I will make thee fruitful, and multiply thee, and I will make of thee a multitude of people; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession.

48:5.web: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.
48:5.kjv: And now thy two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto thee in the land of Egypt before I came unto thee into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
