48:6.web: Your issue, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
48:6.kjv: And thy issue, which thou begettest after them, shall be thine, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

48:7.web: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”
48:7.kjv: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Bethlehem.

48:8.web: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”
48:8.kjv: And Israel beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?

48:9.web: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”
48:9.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom God hath given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray thee, unto me, and I will bless them.

48:10.web: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see. He brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
48:10.kjv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

48:11.web: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”
48:11.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see thy face: and, lo, God hath shewed me also thy seed.

48:12.web: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
48:12.kjv: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

48:13.web: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.
48:13.kjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near unto him.

48:14.web: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
48:14.kjv: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

48:15.web: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
48:15.kjv: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,

bsb: by my name and the names
48:16.web: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”
48:16.kjv: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

48:17.web: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
48:17.kjv: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

48:18.web: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father; for this is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”
48:18.kjv: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put thy right hand upon his head.

48:19.web: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”
48:19.kjv: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

48:20.web: He blessed them that day, saying, “In you will Israel bless, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.
48:20.kjv: And he blessed them that day, saying, In thee shall Israel bless, saying, God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

48:21.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.
48:21.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

48:22.web: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”
48:22.kjv: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

49:1.web: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.
49:1.kjv: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

49:2.web: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.
49:2.kjv: Gather yourselves together, and hear, ye sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Israel your father.

49:3.web: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.
49:3.kjv: Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

49:4.web: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.
49:4.kjv: Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

49:5.web: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.
49:5.kjv: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

49:6.web: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.
49:6.kjv: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

49:7.web: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.
49:7.kjv: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

49:8.web: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.
49:8.kjv: Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father’s children shall bow down before thee.

49:9.web: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?
49:9.kjv: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

49:10.web: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. To him will the obedience of the peoples be.
49:10.kjv: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

49:11.web: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
49:11.kjv: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

49:12.web: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.
49:12.kjv: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

bsb: by the seashore and become a harbor
49:13.web: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.
49:13.kjv: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

49:14.web: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
49:14.kjv: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

49:15.web: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.
49:15.kjv: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

49:16.web: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
49:16.kjv: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

49:17.web: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.
49:17.kjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

49:18.web: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.
49:18.kjv: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.

49:19.web: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.
49:19.kjv: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

49:20.web: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.
49:20.kjv: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

49:21.web: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.
49:21.kjv: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.

49:22.web: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.
49:22.kjv: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

49:23.web: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:
49:23.kjv: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

49:24.web: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),
49:24.kjv: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Israel:)

49:25.web: even by the God of your father, who will help you; by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.
49:25.kjv: Even by the God of thy father, who shall help thee; and by the Almighty, who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lieth under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

49:26.web: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.
49:26.kjv: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

49:27.web: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”
49:27.kjv: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

bsb: He blessed them, and he blessed
49:28.web: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his blessing.
49:28.kjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

49:29.web: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
49:29.kjv: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

49:30.web: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.
49:30.kjv: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

49:31.web: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:
49:31.kjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

49:32.web: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”
49:32.kjv: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

49:33.web: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the spirit, and was gathered to his people.
49:33.kjv: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

50:1.web: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.
50:1.kjv: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

50:2.web: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.
50:2.kjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Israel.

50:3.web: Forty days were fulfilled for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for him for seventy days.
50:3.kjv: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

50:4.web: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
50:4.kjv: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

50:5.web: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”
50:5.kjv: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shalt thou bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray thee, and bury my father, and I will come again.

bsb: he made you swear to do.”
50:6.web: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”
50:6.kjv: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury thy father, according as he made thee swear.

50:7.web: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,
50:7.kjv: And Joseph went up to bury his father: and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,

50:8.web: All the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
50:8.kjv: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father’s house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

50:9.web: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.
50:9.kjv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen: and it was a very great company.

50:10.web: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.
50:10.kjv: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad, which is beyond Jordan, and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation: and he made a mourning for his father seven days.

bsb: at the threshing floor of Atad,
50:11.web: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
50:11.kjv: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians: wherefore the name of it was called Abel-mizraim, which is beyond Jordan.

50:12.web: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,
50:12.kjv: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:

50:13.web: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.
50:13.kjv: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

50:14.web: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.
50:14.kjv: And Joseph returned into Egypt, he, and his brethren, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

50:15.web: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
50:15.kjv: And when Joseph’s brethren saw that their father was dead, they said, Joseph will peradventure hate us, and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him.

50:16.web: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,
50:16.kjv: And they sent a messenger unto Joseph, saying, Thy father did command before he died, saying,

50:17.web: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
50:17.kjv: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

50:18.web: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”
50:18.kjv: And his brethren also went and fell down before his face; and they said, Behold, we be thy servants.

50:19.web: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
50:19.kjv: And Joseph said unto them, Fear not: for am I in the place of God?

50:20.web: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is today, to save many people alive.
50:20.kjv: But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

50:21.web: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will nourish you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.
50:21.kjv: Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

50:22.web: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.
50:22.kjv: And Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he, and his father’s house: and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years.

50:23.web: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
50:23.kjv: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation: the children also of Machir the son Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph’s knees.

50:24.web: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”
50:24.kjv: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I die: and God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

50:25.web: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”
50:25.kjv: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.

50:26.web: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
50:26.kjv: So Joseph died, being an hundred and ten years old: and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
